notes: Inbound from support automation meetup signup (form) — interested in replacing a brittle rules pipeline.
Customer: small SaaS that builds an embeddable support inbox for SMB merchants. Main product: plugin + web portal.

Marc ran a quick lab test during call — estimator shows ~0.8s avg response for 512-token summarization on their dev dataset; wants p95 under 400ms which may require batching/shorter contexts.
Customer asked about structured JSON outputs for CRS ingestion — Redwood structured output + schema enforcement callout noted as selling point.
They signed up for a free account earlier today (automated), came in via product landing page. AE follow-up within 24h recommended.
Drive doc linked: sample tickets + column mapping (ticket_id, convo_text, customer_notes, order_id).

requirements_summary: SMB, public-cloud hosted API POC.
